chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from Abu Ali al-Wasiti, who raised it to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), saying:
Indeed, when the woman ages, the goodness of her two halves departs and her evil remains; her beauty departs, her womb becomes barren, and her tongue becomes sharp (rages).

key_terms.شَطْرَيْهَا: her two halves (referring to body and soul or physical and spiritual aspects)

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of aging in women according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) elucidates the concept of 'scarcity of righteousness' by linking the decline of physical beauty and fertility to the persistence or intensification of character flaws, particularly a sharp tongue. This narration reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that aging can strip away the veil of youthful charm, revealing the inner disposition, which often inclines towards irritability or dominance in women. It serves as a practical reminder for spouses and family members to exercise patience and discernment in marital relationships as partners age.
